admission_rule.MAG1: pole regularity and finite magnetic-energy representation
admission_rule.SW_GEOM: min_theta(H0+eta0_A)>0 and thin-shell geometry remains admissible
admission_rule.EQRES: gstar*deta0_A/dtheta - ((U0^2-vA^2)*cot(theta)+2*Omega_frame*r_t*U0*cos(theta)) = 0 within the frozen numerical equilibrium criterion

provenance.citation: Dikpati (2006), The importance of the solar tachocline, Advances in Space Research 38:839-844, DOI 10.1016/j.asr.2005.07.016; Gilman & Rempel (2005), ApJ 630:615-622, DOI 10.1086/431929.
provenance.claim: ~100 kG is a standard strong-toroidal-field tachocline regime in flux-emergence/dynamo literature.

provenance.citation: Multilayer Magnetohydrodynamic Shallow-water Model of the Solar Tachocline: Equilibrium Shape and Thickness, ApJ, DOI 10.3847/1538-4357/ae314e.
provenance.claim: Recent helioseismic discussion states that tachocline toroidal amplitudes are poorly constrained and that less than ~300 kG is the strongest broad bound that can be asserted.

provenance.citation: Preregistered intermediate regime anchor, not asserted as a direct observational estimate.
provenance.claim: Included before BURGAMOTS outcomes to span the independently motivated strong-field regime.
